en.headline: Ocean Park Halloween Fest continues through 1 November with Grave Rave experiences
en.dek: Daytime access runs until 1 November while selected night sessions feature the Under the Castle haunted experience linked to Jackson Wang’s fantasy IP.
body: Ocean Park’s Halloween Fest 2026, themed The Grave Rave, remains open with daytime experiences running from 5 September through 1 November. Selected night sessions with haunted experiences operate on designated dates through 1 November, including dates this week.

The organisers said the season features the Under the Castle Haunted Experience, developed from an original fantasy IP founded and creatively directed by Jackson Wang, along with other haunted houses such as Voodoo Boo Terror Park, Troublesome Night 8 and Forbidden Asylum. Standard admission is listed at HK$538 for adults and HK$269 for children aged 3 to 11.

Additional offerings include live performances, a cosplay gathering and roaming characters. The Hong Kong Tourism Board lists the event as organised by Ocean Park Corporation and running until 1 November.

zh.headline: 海洋公園哈囉喂全園祭持續至11月1日 以詭魅墓會為主題
zh.dek: 日間體驗至11月1日，指定晚間場次設有王嘉爾原創奇幻IP「Under the Castle」驚嚇體驗。
body: 海洋公園哈囉喂全園祭2026以「詭魅墓會」為主題，日間體驗由9月5日持續至11月1日。指定日子的日連夜驚嚇體驗亦運作至11月1日，本周仍有場次。
園方表示，今季重點包括由王嘉爾創立並擔任創意總監的原創奇幻IP「Under the Castle」驚嚇體驗，以及其他鬼屋如Voodoo Boo惡靈遊樂場、陰陽路及瘋人院。標準入場門票成人538元，3至11歲小童269元。
活動亦有現場表演、Cosplay派對及出巡角色。香港旅遊發展局資料顯示，活動由海洋公園公司舉辦，至11月1日結束。
